## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `ForYou-Music-{{VERSION}}.apk` | Android 7.0 or newer |
| `ForYou-Music-{{VERSION}}-x86_64.AppImage` | Linux, 64-bit |

**Android:** if you already have ForYou Music, tap **Update** on the card in the app. Otherwise open the `.apk` and allow installing from your browser or file manager when asked.

**Linux:** install `libmpv` and `libfuse2` first (`sudo apt install libmpv2 libfuse2` on Debian and Ubuntu), then:

```sh
chmod +x ForYou-Music-{{VERSION}}-x86_64.AppImage
./ForYou-Music-{{VERSION}}-x86_64.AppImage
```

## Found a problem?

Open an issue and paste the details from **Settings > Help > Copy app info**. You can also email azaralfy01@gmail.com.
